observations.code_quote: - A source's per-endpoint URL versions (a hardcoded `/v2/...`, `/v3/...` in the endpoint config) are independent of the framework's source-level version label. A source may already call the vendor's newest per-resource routes while still carrying the `UNVERSIONED_API_VERSION` default — so a version-add can be correct as declaration-only even when the vendor's own version numbers look far apart. Diff what the source actually requests, not the vendor's headline version.
